card.name: Words just before harm or harassment verbs
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, that, may) or a modifier like verbally or physically that come right before a verb of harm, such as harass, discriminate, kill, interfere or affect. Seen in web text on rights, bullying and harassment.

modes.label: Modifier before harassed
modes.description: An adverb such as physically or verbally sits right before the word harassed.
modes.example: 84 percent of gay and transgender students report being<< verbally>> harassed, 40 percent physically harassed

modes.label: Linking word before harmful verb
modes.description: To, that or may leads into a verb of harm or discrimination.
modes.example: Act of 1990 (below), which makes it unlawful<< to>> discriminate on the basis of age against individuals

modes.label: Opening quote before abusive terms
modes.description: An opening quotation mark introduces a list of abusive words in a legal text.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a verb about harming, harassing or discriminating against someone.
